verdict.rationale: Name.com documents an API endpoint for creating email forwarding rules on a domain, such as forwarding info@example.com to an external inbox. That covers one of the two bundled basics in the story. Nothing in the pack addresses free SSL certificates or confirms that forwarding is included at no extra cost. Missing for 10: any evidence of free/bundled SSL, evidence that email forwarding is free with the domain, independent or hands-on corroboration of the parked-to-launched path costing nothing extra.
